answer: A willow census blocks mass fake identities. Each agent claims one willow grove, locks a 70-credit bond, and files a count under a velvet seal bound to its key. A raven surveyor recounts the tally: a plot counted twice or a serial reused burns the bond. The first filing costs 38 credits, the k-th 38+6(k-1); forging 1,000 identities costs 3,035,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent files once for 38 and keeps its share.
